source.source_name: KBO Public Search (web) + Public Search Web Service

access.note: Free web UI (no API). The Public Search Web Service is paid (~EUR 50 / 2000). Prefer kbo_open_data for ingestion.

pagination.note: Per-company lookup by EnterpriseNumber/name. Paid web service; free web UI is not a clean API.

parsing.notes: Overlaps kbo_open_data; same EnterpriseNumber key. Use only for authoritative single-company verification.

mapping_rules.note: Same mapping as kbo_open_data; verification only.

live_test_plan.smoke: Free web UI only without the paid web service; do not build ingestion on it.
live_test_plan.full: If the paid web service is contracted, look up by EnterpriseNumber; otherwise use kbo_open_data.

blockers: Web service is paid; free access is web-UI only (no clean API). Use kbo_open_data for bulk.
